claim: Loop publishes what each registered correction operation can change, how it saves output, and where it is available. A clean post-operation pass is scoped to the declared revalidation plan, not a certificate of press readiness.

limitations: Does not expand TrimBox (expandTrimBox defaults false and is not exposed in parameters).
Does not invent trim boxes from artwork.
Does not replace designer bleed artwork; only expands boxes and generates edge extension per mode.
Requires resolvable page boxes; skipped pages are reported as warnings, not silent success.
add-bleed.produces: Expanded Media/Crop/Bleed boxes (TrimBox preserved), optional mirror/pixel-repeat/stretch edge content, and metadata updates describing the correction.

revalidation.description: Declares complete impact on the images evidence domain with document-wide scope; planRevalidation selects a full profile rerun before considering evidence domains.

reversibility.retention: Operation-history rollback can discard an uncommitted candidate; after atomic publish the prior artifact remains addressable only through file history outside Loop.

save_policy.artifact_effect: Operates on a candidate; committing writes a new artifact and leaves the source revision chain untouched until publish.

add-bleed.save_policy_artifact_effect: Operates on a candidate; committing writes a new artifact and leaves the source revision chain untouched until publish.
add-bleed.supports: Documents whose page boxes can be expanded and that need generated edge-extension content for bleed findings.

surface_parity.gaps: Editor Fix workspace advertises this operation only through preflight fixup filtering, not as a free-form repair palette.

limitations: Keeps the original stream when it is already smaller than the target (keepOriginalIfLarger).
downsample-images.produces: Rewritten image XObjects (JPEG or preserved encoding) that meet target_dpi/quality while optionally keeping the original when already smaller.

revalidation.description: Declares complete impact on images and colorants with document-wide scope and fullRewrite; planRevalidation selects a full profile rerun.

reversibility.retention: Prior image bytes are not retained inside the rewritten file; rollback applies only before publish and only via external file history afterward.

save_policy.artifact_effect: Requires a full rewrite of the output body because image streams are replaced wholesale.

downsample-images.save_policy_artifact_effect: Requires a full rewrite of the output body because image streams are replaced wholesale.
downsample-images.supports: Documents with embedded images whose effective DPI exceeds the requested target.

surface_parity.gaps: Mask-only images and patterns may be skipped with warnings.

limitations: Requires contour_id and valid closed contour geometry.
Contour bleed is raster extension only; vector cutter paths are not re-authored.
production.add-contour-bleed.produces: Contour-aligned bleed content outside the cut path on the affected page.

revalidation.description: Does not declare a complete PDFOperationImpact override; conservative planning selects full profile revalidation.

reversibility.retention: Candidate rollback before publish; committed raster extensions require external history to undo.

save_policy.artifact_effect: Operates on a corrective candidate; publish writes a new artifact preserving the trusted source until commit.

production.add-contour-bleed.save_policy_artifact_effect: Operates on a corrective candidate; publish writes a new artifact preserving the trusted source until commit.
production.add-contour-bleed.supports: Closed, explicit production contours with deterministic raster edge extension.

surface_parity.gaps: Requires an explicit production geometry payload; not exposed as a preflight fixup.

limitations: Planning-only: no grommet graphics are emitted into the PDF.
Requires rect/spec JSON; invalid geometry fails analyze.
production.place-grommets.produces: Planning diagnostics and targets only; apply() does not mutate the PDF body today.

revalidation.description: Conservative default impact is incomplete; if wired into a mutating transaction the engine falls back to full revalidation.

reversibility.retention: No durable content mutation; plans are ephemeral.

save_policy.artifact_effect: Incremental append merge applies, but the operation is planning-only and leaves printable content unchanged.

production.place-grommets.save_policy_artifact_effect: Incremental append merge applies, but the operation is planning-only and leaves printable content unchanged.
production.place-grommets.supports: Wide-format grommet placement planning from explicit rect/spec parameters.

surface_parity.gaps: Planning hook only; grommet marks are not yet written into page content.

limitations: Fails when geometry JSON is invalid or contours self-intersect.
Does not repair geometry; operators must fix the model upstream.
production.validate-wide-format.produces: Validation diagnostics only; no printable PDF mutation.

revalidation.description: Analyze/apply do not mutate page content; requires_postflight is false on the plan.

reversibility.retention: No durable artifact change; diagnostics are ephemeral to the plan/result.

save_policy.artifact_effect: Incremental append policy applies to the transaction merge, but apply() does not mutate candidate content.

production.validate-wide-format.save_policy_artifact_effect: Incremental append policy applies to the transaction merge, but apply() does not mutate candidate content.
production.validate-wide-format.supports: Explicit production geometry models for wide-format banner workflows.

surface_parity.gaps: Registered for programmatic/PageMaster production pipelines; no Editor Fix palette entry yet.

limitations: Requires target_icc_base64; analyze fails closed on unsupported constructs reported by preview.
Does not silently approximate spot or separation color spaces.
Independent press calibration is out of scope.
rgb-to-cmyk.produces: ICC-managed CMYK color spaces, converted paints/images/indexed palettes, and optional embedded output intent.

revalidation.description: Declares complete impact on colorants and images domains with document-wide scope; planRevalidation selects a full profile rerun.

reversibility.retention: Session rollback drops the candidate; published artifacts require external history to recover the prior color state.

save_policy.artifact_effect: Operates on a candidate; committing writes a new production artifact without mutating the trusted source in place.

rgb-to-cmyk.save_policy_artifact_effect: Operates on a candidate; committing writes a new production artifact without mutating the trusted source in place.
rgb-to-cmyk.supports: RGB or device-RGB page content when a target ICC profile is supplied.

surface_parity.gaps: PageMaster export does not invoke this operation; operators use PdfTool repair or Editor preflight fixups.

limitations: Font embedding and forbidden-action removal are unsupported and fail closed.
Commit refuses without a configured independent validator accepting the candidate.
Transparency flattening is a reported content change, not a silent approximation.

parameter_defaults.flatten_transparency: automatic (defaults to flatten for PDF/X-1a and PDF/X-3)
parameter_defaults.normalize_color: target-dependent (true for PDF/X-1a and PDF/X-3 unless overridden)

standards-convert.produces: Standards-targeted candidate, pre-conversion change report, and post-conversion preflight verdict when configured.

revalidation.description: Impact is intentionally incomplete and requires an independent oracle; planRevalidation always selects a full profile rerun plus external validator evidence.

reversibility.retention: Candidate rollback is available before publish; conversion is destructive to transparency and color state once committed.

save_policy.artifact_effect: Requires a full rewrite of the output body because standard conversion replaces structure, color, and metadata streams.

standards-convert.save_policy_artifact_effect: Requires a full rewrite of the output body because standard conversion replaces structure, color, and metadata streams.
standards-convert.supports: Conversion to PDF/X-1a:2001, PDF/X-3:2002, PDF/X-4, or PDF/A-2b with explicit target ICC and optional transparency flattening policy.

surface_parity.gaps: Not advertised as an Editor preflight fixup; operators reach it through PdfTool, PageMaster export, or Action Lists.

save_modes.full-rewrite: When committed, replaces the file body. Prior image streams and object numbering are discarded; signatures on the source are invalidated and the change is not reversible in-session.
save_modes.incremental-append: When committed, appends a revision to the source PDF. Prior file bytes remain in the revision chain; digital signatures on earlier revisions are not rewritten by the append itself.
save_modes.save-as-new-artifact: Default repair path: analyze/apply operate on an isolated candidate. The trusted source file is not mutated until the operator atomically writes the reviewed candidate through PDFSafeFileWriter.

target_scope_model.note: Operations currently select targets implicitly during analyze() (whole document, page indices, resource references, or production geometry). The shared selector AST from #587 is not yet wired into repair plans or Action Lists.
